regime_context: The detector shows a single dominant, trend-eligible narrative (Banks) with extreme breadth (0.94) and crowding (z=1.98), alongside a narrow eligible rotation (only Banks and Coal pass the absolute-trend gate). However, the backtest verdict explicitly states the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on China A-shares history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), and the track record shows direction accuracy of 0.337 with a 0.52 hit rate — so this desk note is deliberately low-conviction with a single checkable conditional lean.
emerging_watch: Watching Coal (515220.SS) as the only other trend-eligible theme (score 0.887, hurst_tag='mean-revert', breadth only 0.2). I am watching for Coal to show breadth expansion above 0.5 and a rotation margin between Banks and Coal below 0.05 — that handoff confirmation would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme simultaneously passing the absolute-trend gate, holding the top durability bar (0.87), showing trend health (hurst_tag='trend'), and displaying very high breadth (0.944) — the classic large-cap/state-bank value leadership pattern on the CSI 300. The crowding flag (z=1.98) is a size-down caution, not a fade signal, per guardrails. The lean is directional only: remain on the long side of the dominant, confirmed narrative while it holds trend-gate eligibility and breadth above roughly 0.8.
theses.dissent: The strongest bear case is that this is a crowded, one-narrative tape (crowding z=1.98, one_narrative=true) in a market where the trend gate has no historical drawdown-control edge (gate_helps=false); if the mean-reverting tape whipsaws the gate, Banks could reverse sharply precisely because it is the most crowded leadership. Direction accuracy of 0.337 on the ensemble record is barely better than a coin flip.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) loses its trend-gate eligibility or breadth falls below 0.7 before the 20-day check-by date
